definitions.explanation: A previous case or instance that can serve as a reference or standard for similar situations. Often used in legal, administrative, and formal contexts.

examples.japanese: {前例|ぜんれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧だ。
⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前例|ぜんれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: To make a judgment following past precedent.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に{関|かん}して→に関して：06944_nikanshite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前例|ぜんれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Since there is no precedent for this issue, it needs to be handled carefully.

notes:
{前例|ぜんれい} refers to a past case used as a reference for current decisions. Composed of ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (previous) + ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ (example/case).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前例|ぜんれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unprecedented
- {前例|ぜんれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow precedent
- {前例|ぜんれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to set a precedent
- {前例|ぜんれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no precedent
- {前例|ぜんれい}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧: precedent-based approach (often used critically)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese organizations — government offices, schools, companies — often rely heavily on precedent. The phrase {前例|ぜんれい}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (following precedent blindly) is sometimes used critically to describe bureaucratic inflexibility.

RELATED WORDS:
- {先例|せんれい}: precedent (similar meaning, more formal/legal)
